stage: selected on dev before running agent test
criterion: Use the retrieval choice fixed on dev; among agent configurations prefer more answerable dev questions answered with valid in-context citation IDs, correct refusal on both unanswerable dev questions, then lower model cost and median latency. Semantic support is audited separately.
selection_note: Dev answer status and citation-ID validity are necessary checks, not semantic answer grades. Two dev errors and source support were read manually; test answers will be graded by reading their citations.
